200 Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management successfully deleted the specified exclusion.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
any
— 403 Returned if you do not have permission to delete the exclusion.
— 404 Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management could not find the specified exclusion.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
